```yaml
name: Release v1.0 with Ollama Support

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'package.json'
      - 'lib/**'
      - 'src/**'
      - '.github/workflows/release.yml'

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Build package
        run: npm run build

  publish-release:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org/'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build package
        run: npm run build

      - name: Publish to npm
        run: npm publish
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: v1.0.0-ollama-support
          release_name: Release v1.0 with Ollama Support
          body: |
            This release restores Ollama provider support for v1.0.
            
            ## Changes
            - Reintroduced Ollama provider integration
            - Added Ollama to provider registry
            - Updated model configuration system
            - Enhanced documentation
            
            ## Use Cases
            - Privacy-conscious deployments
            - Organizations with data sovereignty requirements
            - Development without API costs
            - Users in regions with limited API access
            
            For more details, see:
            - Issue #680
            - PR #552
            - Ollama AI Provider v2: https://github.com/nordwestt/ollama-ai-provider-v2
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
```
